label: P-LR0
result:
P-LR0 is built and committed. The new tests pass and lint is clean. The parity test records a known gap on Today, and four limits (below) are open.

**Head:** `99e8c569e30402cf5d1504aca6fcb3fd1a1f13ed` on `web/learn-review-1017`, worktree `C:\Users\atish\Desktop\mockmob copy\wt-lr17`. It is cut from f725a422, with `node_modules` junctioned and `.env.local` copied (gitignored). Nothing is pushed or deployed.

**Tests:**
- `test:recovery` runs 464 tests: 461 pass, 3 todo, 0 fail. The four new test files are added to that script.
- `test:today` (28), `test:egress` (29) and `test:app` (498) pass.
- `test:study` has one failure, `study_content.test.mjs` with `LICENSE_UNAVAILABLE` for wordnet. It is not caused by this change; I did not run it on the base commit.

**What was built:**
- `data/review_input.mjs` has `reviewInput(record)`, which feeds the result page's own `nextMove()`, so there is no second builder. It also has `reviewMove`, `chapterRows`, `receipt`, `reviseDue`, `reviewCounts`, `mistakesHead` and `reviewBody`. On the design student it returns Repair Q42 in Mock 3. With 0 AI credits it returns "Practise 10 on Admission of a partner". Every design number matches `check.mjs`.
- `data/tests/fixtures/review/` holds `student.json` (an unchanged copy), `check_pending`, `zero_credits`, `all_held`, `one_paper`, `revise_dedupe`, `empty`, `record_down`, plus an extra `nothing_missed` and a generated `expected.json`. `scripts/gen_review_fixtures.mjs` writes the variants.
- `data/tests/next_move_parity.test.mjs`: result and Review give the same move on one paper (kind, rule, label, price, target) and on the other shared result fixtures. Today agrees on the kind and on the paper its key opens.
- `GET /api/me/review` is `src/app/api/me/review/route.js` plus `src/lib/server/review.js`, read-only. The tests use PostgREST-shaped rows with a column whitelist, and the design student rebuilt as database rows gives the same numbers.
- `data/study/lesson_map.mjs` has `lessonFor`, `lessonsForChapters`, `lessonHref` and `parseFrom`. The "Start the lesson" key reads Learn plus 2 minutes of Lock it in.
- Migration `20261017160000_revise_cards_mode.sql` with an undo file. On staging only (`onwkqxmjqjrhfbjjdydu`) the dry run rolled back clean (rows stayed 105 and the check rejected a bad value), then I applied it. Staging is left migrated. Production is untouched, and the code works without the column. The evidence is at the end of the migration file and in `docs/brain/STATUS.md`.

**API shapes the web packets must use:**
- **Failure:** 401 signed out; 429 rate-limited. On a failed read of papers or saved repairs it returns 503 `{version:1, state:'unavailable', message, cause}`, never the empty state.
- **Empty:** a new account returns 200 with `state:'empty'` and empty `papers`, `chapters` and `items`.
- **Ready (200):** `{version:1, state:'ready', now, wallet, papers[], chapters[], items[], receipt, reviseDue, counts, head, revise, repairOrder:null, partial, papersTotal}`.
  - **`wallet`:** `{aiCredits, aiRenews, practiceCredits, isPremium}`. `null` means unknown, never 0.
  - **`papers[]`:** `{id, name, subject, subjectName, kind, mode, at, questions, right, wrong, blank, score, of, stamp, when}`. `stamp` reads "Mock 3, 16 Oct, 9:40 PM".
  - **`chapters[]`:** priced and costliest first, `{id, name, subject, subjectName, marks, openWrong, blank, wrong, repaired, slipped, pending, held, keyHeld, papers[], source, progress, itemIds[]}`.
  - **`items[]`:** `{uid, qid, paper, attemptId, q, number, ch, chapterId, chapter, state, keyState, pick, stem, pill, paperName, at, stamp, repairedAt, checkedAt, reviseNext, reviseNextLabel, open, repairable}`.
    - `state` is `open | slipped | repaired | held | blank`.
    - `keyState` is `null | 'under_review'`.
    - `pill` uses the RESULT chip words.
    - `uid` is `${attemptId}:${qid}`.
  - **`receipt`:** `{found, repaired, retested, stillRight, line, slip, onlyFound}`.
  - **`reviseDue`:** `{questions, again, checks, cards, total, minutes, cap, unknown[], head, mix, row}`. `unknown` names a part whose read failed, and its count is 0 in the total.
  - **`counts`:** `{found, open, blanks, marks, openPapers, papers, lost, slipped, pending}`.
  - **`head`:** `{title, sub}`.
  - **`partial`:** `true` when older papers fall outside the window. Only the newest 40 papers are read; `papersTotal` counts all.
- **Next move:** call `reviewMove(body)` from `data/review_input.mjs` on the body. It returns `{kind, rule, label, why, value, cost, late, alt, note, target:{qid, uid, attemptId, paper, number, chapter}, panel:{title, line}}`.
- **Request options:** `?cap=5` sets Revise's daily cap. The body never carries a key, option, explanation or rule text.

**Known gap and open limits:**
- **Today:** it repairs a batch ("Start repair" opening the paper's result page, counting the newest paper). It cannot name "Repair Q42" until the TODAY owner changes the wording (LEARN-REVIEW-1017 section 12, flag 2). The parity test records this as three `todo` tests that state the wanted equality and currently fail; they are not faked green.
- **Repair order:** the API has no cohort repair order, so on the design student it names Q38 (lowest open number in Mock 3), not Q42. Sending `repairOrder: [uid…]` in the record gives Q42; I did not build that read.
- **Pricing:** Review prices open items across papers, while the result page prices all of a paper's wrong answers. They agree on one paper with no repairs.
- **Revise minutes:** `minutesFor` gives about 10 minutes for 8 due; the design mock says 7.
- **Left to P-LR2:** the Review-again answer endpoint and the merged due list.
- **Note:** a wrong answer later answered right elsewhere stays "open" in this version, as the doc specifies.
